To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the reactivity of the model fuel in the gas-phase is strongly influenced by the chemical structure of the additives; (ii) the EHN additive is able to reduce the reactivity of a model fuel in a wide range of experimental conditions, including the compression ratio of an engine; (iii) the ferrocene additive is able to increase the reactivity of model fuel in the shock tube and rapid compression machine, but has a negligible effect in the flat flame burner.
